name: Home header
purpose: Tops the home screen: the GOV.UK wordmark on blue, and the search field the user starts a search of GOV.UK from. It takes the place of the navigation bar, which the home screen hides.

origin.notes: HomeViewController's header: the wordmark (homeLogo), 28pt tall, centred 16pt below the status bar, and a UISearchBar 16pt below it, on fills.surfaceHomeHeaderBackground, which fills the status bar too. The content scrolls under it. Android's HomeScreen draws the same: the wordmark, a heading, 16dp from the top, and below it a header widget, its search field. This draws the iOS spacing.

inputs.content: Optionally, a <govuk-app-search-field>, drawn below the wordmark, as on the app's home screen. Without one, the header is the wordmark alone, as when the app's search is turned off.

rules: Use it only on the home screen, in place of a navigation bar. Other screens have a navigation bar.
Put it first in a <govuk-app-screen>. It sticks to the top of the screen, and the content scrolls under it.
Give it a search field, as the app does, unless the prototype is of the app without search.
The wordmark is the screen's heading, so don't give the home screen another level 1 heading.

avoid.when: To search on a screen other than Home
